chunks: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people: "Do you commit obscenity while you see [its evil]?"

key_terms.الْفَاحِشَةَ: The obscenity (specifically sodomy in this context)

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Lot say to his people about their sexual immorality?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the moral culpability of Lot's people by emphasizing 'tubṣirūn' (seeing/awareness), indicating their sin was not due to ignorance but a deliberate rejection of divine signs. This highlights the concept of *'ilm al--yaqīn* (certainty of knowledge) preceding their punishment, serving as a warning that awareness of the truth does not exempt one from accountability for their actions.
